seo.title: Content · KatiMarket Admin
seo.description: Storefront content administration for the KatiMarket admin panel.

announcements.title: Announcement bar
announcements.description: Active messages scroll across the top of the storefront. 120 characters maximum.
announcements.empty: No announcements. Add the first message.

list.changedFields: no changed fields | 1 changed field | {count} changed fields

detail.empty: Select a proposition to inspect its changes.
detail.disappearanceWarning: Accepting this proposal will retire the product from the catalogue.
detail.creationNotice: Accepting this proposal will create the product in the catalogue.
detail.readOnly: Only Direction can accept or refuse a proposition.

refuse.title: Refuse this proposition
refuse.description: Add a short reason. It will be kept in the decision history.
refuse.placeholder: Why should this proposition be refused?

toast.conflict: This proposition changed before your decision. The latest version is now shown.

emplacement.principalHint: The large carousel at the top of the home page. Its artwork must be wider than it is tall.
emplacement.promoHint: The campaign cards in the KatiMarket home header. Add, remove, and reorder campaigns freely. Portrait or square artwork is recommended.
emplacement.pub_accueilHint: The KatiMarket home page advert, in the right-hand column. A portrait artwork is best (about 600 × 750 px). The first active banner of this placement is shown.

grid.groupEmpty: No banner in this carousel yet.
grid.groupNoResults: No banner in this carousel matches your filters.

panel.title: Banner details
panel.description: View and manage this storefront banner.
panel.notFound: This banner could not be found. It may have been removed.
panel.mobileMissing: None: phones get the large artwork, cropped around the focus point.
panel.publishError: Could not update the publish state. Please try again.
panel.deleteConfirmDescription: This removes the banner and its artworks permanently. This cannot be undone.

form.emplacementMoveHint: Changing the placement moves the banner to the end of the other carousel.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: A short sentence shown below the title
form.altPlaceholder: Describe the artwork for screen readers

phone.label: Phone artwork
phone.noneDetail: It is cropped around the focus point ({focus}%). Drag the line on the large artwork to choose what stays in view.
phone.noneDetailNoArtwork: Add the large artwork first. Phones will show it, cropped around the focus point.
phone.ownDetail: Shown on phones instead of the large artwork.

artwork.dropzoneLabel: Drop an image or click to upload
artwork.mobileRemoved: The phone artwork will be removed when you save.
artwork.unsupportedFormat: Choose a JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
artwork.measureFailed: Could not read this image. Try a different file.
artwork.sizeWarning: This file is over 15 MB and may be slow to upload.
artwork.largeNotLandscape: A main banner must be wider than it is tall. Put a square or portrait artwork in Promo.
artwork.mobileNotNarrower: The phone artwork must be narrower than the large artwork.

siteTexts.heading: Site texts
siteTexts.openLink: Site texts (legal pages, About, FAQ, e-mails)

seo.title: Site texts · KatiMarket Administration
seo.description: Writing and publishing the legal pages, the FAQ and the e-mails.

siteTexts.forbidden: Your role cannot write the site texts. The direction chooses which roles may write.
siteTexts.pick: Pick a text in the list to read or edit it.
siteTexts.rolesHelp: The direction always writes and publishes. Tick the roles that may also write and submit a text; only the direction publishes.
siteTexts.notLive: Not published yet: the site shows its original text.
siteTexts.notLiveEmail: Not customised yet: the e-mail is sent with its original text. “Edit” starts from that text.
siteTexts.englishLateHelp: The French changed but the English did not follow: the English site will show the French until the English is updated.
siteTexts.englishConfirmed: I have reviewed the English: it matches the French.
siteTexts.sentBack: Text sent back to the writer.
siteTexts.markupHelp: One paragraph per block separated by an empty line, one bullet per line. Formatting available: **bold** and [link text](/page).
siteTexts.emailHelp: The greeting, signature and link are added automatically. Available variables:
siteTexts.linkedSheet: Also updates the “{sheet}” sheet (assistant and checkout page).

readings.title: Reading of the latest important change
readings.none: No important change published since the initial version: nothing for shops to read.
readings.count: Version {number}: {read} of {total} shop(s) have read it.
